method: Ran ten offline assertions. The verifier compiles the lesson Python fence, checks lexical proxies and Han counting, response/usage fail-closed paths, all 24 fake Anthropic request slots, archive overwrite protection and stdout privacy. It also checks that the lesson scopes mid-conversation system messages to Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8 and links the official Messages guide. Reopened current Anthropic Messages and Working with Messages docs on 2026-10-22. No live provider request was made.
limitations: The historical 8-run comparison and 3-run role-conflict observations have no archived per-call prompts, responses, exact model snapshot or scorer and were not reproduced.
The local fake SDK does not establish current Anthropic SDK, endpoint, model behavior, semantic scorer validity, quality, cost or latency.
The lexical keyword/digit flags and Han-character threshold are weak proxies; they require task-specific human calibration.
